Framed Agate Slice Shadow Box
Natural Banded Agate, Purple and White
Vintage Style Decor, 11 x 9 Inches

The slice showcases striking concentric banding in shades of deep purple and translucent white, characteristic of high-quality chalcedony specimens. The deep black frame provides a modern contrast, making it a sophisticated addition to any gallery wall, office, or home decor collection.
Natural banded agate slice with organic edges and crystalline center
Deep purple color transitions into lighter lavender and white bands
Professional shadow box framing with a high-contrast white mat
Integrated sawtooth hanger on the reverse for easy wall mounting
Dimensions: 11 inches length, 9 inches width, 2 inches depth
Condition:

277899477.description:
Alfco NY
Nautical Fisherman with Pipe
Hand Painted Composition / Resin
14.25" H x 5.5" W x 5.5" L
Unsigned (Stamped on base)
This vintage figurine by Alfco NY depicts a classic maritime character, a sea-weathered fisherman clad in a traditional yellow-orange slicker and sou'wester hat while smoking a pipe. The piece is crafted from a durable composition resin designed to emulate the texture and weight of a hand-carved wood sculpture, featuring deep, expressive graining and a warm, aged patina. The character's jovial expression and detailed attire make it a quintessential piece of mid-to-late 20th-century nautical decor.
Authentically marked with the " ALFCO-NY" stamp on the rear of the base
Detailed hand-painted finish highlights the weathered textures of the rain gear and facial features
Substantial 2.2-pound weight provides stability for display on shelves or mantels
Condition:
Good vintage condition. There is a prominent chip and material loss on the top of the hat as shown in photos. The remainder of the figure shows light surface wear and minor scuffing consistent with age. The base is stable and features a circular opening as manufactured.
